claim: Long-lived orchestrators carry about half a million tokens of context on every call, so trivial turns are expensive and slow.

metric.what: Input plus cache-read plus cache-write tokens per model call, per session with over 150 calls.

countedFrom.machine: one Windows 11 machine; one master, 8 orchestrators, about 50 short-lived workers, one person
versions: agent harness as installed in the period (exact version not recorded)

proposedChange: Orchestrators hand over to a fresh session at a size limit, from a maintained lane-state file; batch mail so fewer calls pay for the history.
whyItGeneralises: Context carried on every call is a property of long-lived sessions on any model with per-call billing of history.
